name: Persist Pending Confirmation (Deterministic)
query: INSERT INTO public.flow_up_confirmations (confirmation_id, clinic_id, patient_id, conversation_id, action, target_fingerprint, payload_snapshot, issued_at, expires_at, status) SELECT NULLIF($2::text,'')::uuid, NULLIF($3::text,'')::uuid, NULLIF($4::text,'')::uuid, NULLIF($5::text,'')::uuid, NULLIF($6::text,''), encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(COALESCE(NULLIF($7::text,''), NULLIF($8::text,''), ''),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'), COALESCE(NULLIF($8::text,'')::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), now(), now() + make_interval(secs => $9::int), 'PENDING' WHERE upper($1::text) = 'CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' ON CONFLICT (confirmation_id) DO UPDATE SET clinic_id=EXCLUDED.clinic_id, patient_id=EXCLUDED.patient_id, conversation_id=EXCLUDED.conversation_id, action=EXCLUDED.action, target_fingerprint=EXCLUDED.target_fingerprint, payload_snapshot=EXCLUDED.payload_snapshot, expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at, status='PENDING', consumed_at=NULL WHERE public.flow_up_confirmations.status <> 'CONSUMED' RETURNING confirmation_id, status;
